name: Korilfiend, the Inferno's Provenance
desc:
Korilfiend is the Drowned God of heat, slumbering deep within The Vents, the Third Layer of [The Depths](location:the_depths).

Black Diver [Amorus Pleeksty](entity:amorus_pleeksty), before being reported as missing in action, merged with a meteor flower that was part of Korilfiend, becoming a Deepwoken and inventing Flamecharm as a result. Korilfiend is also the creator of the Forge of Sin, an artifact formerly held at [Temple of the Forgotten Flame](location:the_temple_of_the_forgotten_flame), stolen by [Duke Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia) for his own nefarious purposes.
additional_info:
-   The Deepfire Ring is described to be Korilfiend's. Whether it was used or created by them is unknown.
-   Crimson Megalodaunts appear with a dark red color because they have been exposed to The Vents and have mutated enough to inherit Flamecharming. [Venn Kaelhand](entity:venn_kaelhand), the former owner and likely creator of the First Light is known to have met their demise to one.
